program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = None
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        if len(set(grid[r])) == 1:
            sep = ("row", r)
            break
    if sep is None:
        for c in range(1, w - 1):
            if all(grid[r][c] == grid[0][c] for r in range(h)):
                sep = ("col", c)
                break
    if sep is None:
        raise ValueError("no uniform separator")
    axis, i = sep
    if axis == "row":
        a, b = grid[:i], grid[i + 1:]
        colors = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
        color = next(iter(colors))
        return [[color] * len(a[0]) for _ in range(len(a))]
    a = [row[:i] for row in grid]
    b = [row[i + 1:] for row in grid]
    colors = set(x for row in a for x in row) & set(x for row in b for x in row)
    color = next(iter(colors))
    return [[color] * len(a[0]) for _ in range(len(a))]
'''
